purpose: Teach: 英単語/地中海/フック/麓/猟/カウントダウン/詩集/強風

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、メニューの英単語、もうちょっと、わかりやすくしよか、観光客のお客さんも、来られるからな、本気で、葵、絶対に、わかりやすくせなあかんで、お客様、本当に、便利、感じるわ、絶対。
lines.en: Aoi, let's make the English on the menu a bit clearer—we get tourists coming through, and honestly, it's gotta be easy to understand. Customers really will feel the difference. I'm telling you.
lines.style: Loud, generous, leaning forward with Kansai warmth. Rapid-fire enthusiasm. Taps the counter for emphasis on 「絶対」. Ends on a note of friendly insistence, not pushiness—this is advice from someone who cares.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。地中海料理のフェア、葵で、来月、開催したいですね、本当に、お客様、本気で、喜んでくださいそうですね、絶対、本気で、楽しみな、企画、ですね、本当に、絶対、楽しみ。
lines.en: Yes. I'd really like to hold a Mediterranean cuisine fair next month. I think customers will be genuinely pleased, and I'm truly looking forward to putting it together.
lines.style: Warm, measured response with genuine excitement underneath. Slight lift at the end of each idea—she's imagining it happening. Not rushed. The kind of person who listens first, then commits fully.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 店の看板、フック式、お洒落な、デザインに、葵さん、変えてみよか、本気で、印象、変わるで、絶対、お客さんも、新鮮に、感じてくれるはずやで、本当に、本気、絶対、おすすめや。
lines.en: And the storefront sign—what if we redesign it with a stylish hook-style look? Aoi, it'll really change the impression. Customers will feel the freshness. I'm serious, it's a great idea.
lines.style: Animated, building energy. Gestures openly. Quick rhythm on the suggestions, but sincere—this is someone genuinely invested in the cafe's future. Generous with his excitement, not performative.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。富士山の麓の、食材を、扱う仕入れ先、葵で、開拓したいですね、本気で、地方の名産、扱うこと、お客様、本気で、喜んでくださいそうですね、絶対、本当に、楽しみな、計画、本気。
lines.en: Yes. I'd really like to develop relationships with suppliers at the base of Mount Fuji—the kind who handle local specialties. I think customers would genuinely appreciate having regional products available. I'm really looking forward to making that work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. She's already thinking through logistics as she speaks. Quiet commitment in her voice. Each phrase lands with intention. Not uncertain—just careful and precise.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 昔の狩猟料理、ジビエ、メニューに、加えてみよか、葵さん、本気で、お客さんに、新しい味、提供できるで、絶対、面白い、企画、なるで、本当に、本気で、絶対、頑張ろうな、葵さん。
lines.en: What about adding some game cuisine to the menu—gibier, you know? It'd give us real variety, something customers haven't tried before. That's the kind of menu that stands out. Come on, Aoi—let's make this happen.
lines.style: Earnest but playful. Leans in like he's sharing a secret. The energy is lower here than earlier—this is sincere conviction, not just enthusiasm. Ends with gentle pressure, almost a dare.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。大晦日のカウントダウンイベント、葵で、本気で、開催したいですね、お客様、本気で、楽しんでくださいそうですね、絶対、本気で、企画、進めましょう、葵で、本当に、絶対、楽しみ。
lines.en: Yes. I'd really like to host a New Year's Eve countdown event. I have a feeling customers would genuinely enjoy it, and I'm excited to move forward with the planning.
lines.style: Eager but composed. She's caught between her natural warmth and professional care. The words come faster here—genuine anticipation breaking through. Ends on quiet determination.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 店内に、詩集、置く、葵さん、お洒落な、雰囲気、出るで、絶対、お客さん、ゆっくり、時間、過ごしてくださるよな、絶対、本気で、本当に、いい、アイディアやと思うで、本気、絶対。
lines.en: What if we kept some poetry collections inside the cafe? It'd create a lovely atmosphere, Aoi. Customers would linger longer, spend their time differently. I think it's a genuinely good idea.
lines.style: Animated again, but softer than before. This idea delights him—there's a gentleness underneath. Speaks with the warmth of someone imagining the space he cares about becoming more beautiful.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。強風の日、店、しっかり、戸締まり、徹底しております、葵で、お客様の、安全、絶対、第一です、本気で、本当に、絶対、頑張ってまいります、いつも、本気で、皆、絶対、心がけて。
lines.en: Yes. On windy days, we make sure to secure the storefront properly—that's something we stay on top of. Customer safety comes first, always. I'm committed to keeping everyone safe, and it's something we all focus on seriously.
lines.style: Warm but professional. Quiet confidence in her voice—this is someone who takes care of details that matter. No flourish, just steadiness. Closes with gentle reassurance, the kind that settles people.
